desc:
Welcome to Survive 30 Days in the Sky ☁️

🌤️ Survive day by day as the sky becomes more dangerous
⚡ Random events keep every run unpredictable
🏹 Gather resources & tools to stay alive longer
🏕️ Upgrade your shelter to withstand harsher conditions
🌩️ Face escalating threats as each day gets harder

Every decision matters. Risk it for better rewards or play it safe and survive.

👍 Like the game and join the group for future rewards!
